12 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, Why not vibe coding {#name}

The term is [Andrej Karpathy's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vibe_coding), from a post in February 2025: "There's a new kind of coding I call "vibe coding", where you fully give in to the vibes, embrace exponentials, and forget that the code even exists." He was describing throwaway weekend projects, and by November it was Collins Dictionary's word of the year. In [an article in September](../../saas-apocalypse-decided-by-inertia-not-by-ai.md) I wrote that I did not love it, but that the word had won. I wantwould like to go further now, because the word is doing harm. It sounds as if people are just typing, ad-libbing, going with a feeling; it is a little demeaning to the people doing it, and it hides what is actually happening. I am not alone in this: Andrew Ng [said in May 2025](https://www.aol.com/andrew-ng-says-vibe-coding-065832544.html) "It's unfortunate that that's called vibe coding", and that coding with AI is "a deeply intellectual exercise".
